clos.original_description: Identify and characterize multimodal AI systems and the four core problems of multimodal machine learning - representation, alignment, fusion, and translation.
clos.enriched_description: Identify and characterize multimodal AI systems and the four core problems of multimodal machine learning - representation, alignment, fusion, and translation, including Foundations of Multimodality, What multimodal AI is and isn't, The four core problems: representation, alignment, fusion, translation, Why now: from connectors to native multimodality.

clos.original_description: Build cross-modal representations using contrastive and self-supervised methods, and evaluate them via zero-shot transfer and cross-modal retrieval.
clos.enriched_description: Build cross-modal representations using contrastive and self-supervised methods, and evaluate them via zero-shot transfer and cross-modal retrieval, including Cross-Modal Representation Learning, Contrastive learning and the InfoNCE objective.

clos.original_description: Design and implement fusion architectures (cross-attention, latent bottlenecks, connector modules) that combine heterogeneous modalities.
clos.enriched_description: Design and implement fusion architectures (cross-attention, latent bottlenecks, connector modules) that combine heterogeneous modalities, including Cross-attention as the fusion engine, Perceiver and latent bottlenecks, Q-Former and projection connectors, Flamingo: gated cross-attention.

clos.original_description: Apply vision-language and unified multimodal architectures (LLaVA, BLIP-2, Flamingo, and unified token/diffusion-transformer families) and instruction-tune them.
clos.enriched_description: Apply vision-language and unified multimodal architectures (LLaVA, BLIP-2, Flamingo, and unified token/diffusion-transformer families) and instruction-tune them, including Flamingo: gated cross-attention, Unified-token decoder-only models (Chameleon, Emu3), The discrete-token understanding gap.

clos.original_description: Apply multimodal techniques to non-image modalities - speech, audio, video, 3D, and embodied agents - and to cross-modal generation.
clos.enriched_description: Apply multimodal techniques to non-image modalities - speech, audio, video, 3D, and embodied agents - and to cross-modal generation, including Speech and Audio, Audio as a modality, ASR and Whisper, Audio understanding and audio-LMs, TTS and speech/music generation, Cross-Modal Generation, Text-to-audio and music generation, Video, Why video is hard: temporal structure.

clos.original_description: Engineer multimodal reasoning, agent, and retrieval systems, and address the input-size and latency challenges of deploying them.
clos.enriched_description: Engineer multimodal reasoning, agent, and retrieval systems, and address the input-size and latency challenges of deploying them, including Multimodal Reasoning, Agents and Retrieval, Multimodal reasoning and thinking with images, Computer-use and GUI agents, Cross-modal retrieval and multimodal RAG, Quantization for VLMs, serving multimodal models.

clos.original_description: Evaluate multimodal systems with appropriate benchmarks and protocols, recognizing saturation and the migrating frontier, and run hallucination and grounding diagnostics.
clos.enriched_description: Evaluate multimodal systems with appropriate benchmarks and protocols, recognizing saturation and the migrating frontier, and run hallucination and grounding diagnostics, including Why evaluation is hard, the saturation story (MMMU-Pro) and Where the frontier moved: video, OCR, audio, unified eval.

clos.original_description: Analyze the safety, provenance, bias, and privacy issues specific to multimodal AI - deepfakes, watermarking, and biometric data.
clos.enriched_description: Analyze the safety, provenance, bias, and privacy issues specific to multimodal AI - deepfakes, watermarking, and biometric data, including Safety, Provenance and Frontiers / Course Wrap, The multimodal risk surface, deepfakes and synthetic media, Provenance and watermarking (C2PA), Biometric and facial privacy, bias across modalities.
